title: Distance, Slope and Midpoint Formulas
seo_title: Geometry Distance, Slope and Midpoint Formulas Worksheets (TEKS G.2B)
standard_text: G.2B derive and use the distance, slope, and midpoint formulas to verify geometric relationships, including congruence of segments and parallelism or perpendicularity of pairs of lines
meta_desc: Free Geometry worksheets for Texas TEKS G.2B: the distance, slope and midpoint formulas, radical distances, missing endpoints and coordinate proofs. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Distance comes from the Pythagorean Theorem.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Distance: d = √((x2 − x1)2 + (y2 − y1)2).
  • Slope: (y2 − y1) ÷ (x2 − x1). Equal slopes: parallel. Product −1: perpendicular.
  • Midpoint: average the x's and the y's.
  • Use them to show segments are congruent or lines are parallel or perpendicular.

Examples

Example

(1, 2) and (7, 10)

√(36 + 64)

Answer: 10

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting to squareSquare each difference first.
Subtracting in different ordersUse the same point first.
Adding instead of averagingDivide the sum by 2.

items.q: Find the area of triangle PQR with P(−2, −5), Q(6, −5) and R(4, 2).
items.e: Base PQ is horizontal: 8 units. Height is the vertical distance from R to the base: 7 units. Area = ½ × 8 × 7 = 28 square units.

items.q: Triangle ABC has vertices A(0, −6), B(3, −6) and C(0, −2). Find its area.
items.e: The legs are AB = 3 and AC = 4, and they are perpendicular. Area = ½ × 3 × 4 = 6 square units.

items.q: On a town map, each unit is 0.5 mile. Home is at (2, −1) and school is at (7, 11). What is the straight-line distance between them?
items.e: Distance on the map: √(5² + 12²) = 13 units. Each unit is 0.5 mile, so the distance is 6.5 miles.
